notes.title: Hotfix #23
notes.content: [p]Wanderers, we have an update for Escape the Backrooms rolling out today on Steam!  [/p][p]To be totally clear straight away: this is not the 1.0 release of the game. Escape the Backrooms is still in Early Access, and this is officially ‘Hotfix #23’, with all credit to Secret Mode for going back into the current version and adding patches for some of the bugs we already fixed for 1.0.[/p][p]While we make the final tweaks required for the 1.0 launch, we didn’t want to hold back some fixes and improvements to the current game, so we’re rolling out this small update. It addresses more of the community’s recent feedback and reports, including:  [/p][p] [/p][p]•	Garage: Middle Floor - Some hints will last longer on screen [/p][p]•	Garage: Level 2 - Fixed players being able to walk through a specific wall [/p][p]•	Hotel - Fixed moth jelly occasionally falling through the floor in the Hotel lobby  [/p][p]•	Poolrooms - Stopped the Hydrolitis plague from insta-killing players, and death will now cause ragdolling [/p][p]•	Poolrooms (Expanded) - Fixed Clumps being able to walk into water and get stuck in some areas of the first and third areas [/p][p]•	Level Fun (Expanded) – Improved visuals and disabled flashlights in upper level of zone 3  [/p][p]•	Tunnel – Some hints will last longer on screen, and disabled ability for Bacteria looking up [/p][p] [/p][p]We hope you enjoy this small update, and will keep you in the loop as we complete the final work for the 1.0 launch of Escape the Backrooms![/p]

notes.title: Escape the Backrooms Part 4 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Wanderers, it’s time to return to the backrooms for a new expedition featuring 9 new levels, each bringing you to both new and familiar destinations in the backrooms.

Here are some glimpses of just a few of the new levels you can explore the next time you no-clip into the backrooms:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/e655f6e5406cbfb0eda4667c3b05c40831715e6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/6cdf2f345b990a36223e033e2481242d24b60767.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/7956fd2abefb66a9b0ef63ccfd2e8cd3b8434282.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with the voice chat system
[*] Made small balancing changes to previous levels and items (such as speed boost from items now being double the duration)
[*] Fixed various gameplay bugs
[/list]
There have also been [b]a lot[/b] of changes done behind the scenes to gameplay systems to be able to start implementing better replayability, player progression, events, and more quality of life changes that will be coming soon.

Playing the game is desktop mode is highly recommended for the best experience as VR is still in the very early development stages and may not work as intended.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Christmas Event
notes.content:
Wanderers, if you feel like returning to the backrooms for Christmas, we've added [b]8 player lobbies[/b] for a limited time during the holiday season. It's not much as we've been hard at work on the next major content update, but holidays are always better with others so the more the merrier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/6ab2bc85f94b96397db62b10c67aa28ff0e53917.png[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to create lobbies with 8 players.
[*] Made parts of the poolrooms frozen.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Escape the Backrooms Part 2 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Wanderers, it’s time to return to the backrooms for a new expedition featuring 12 new and expanded levels, 7 new entities, and a complete overhaul of the game mechanics.

Here are some of the new levels you can explore the next time you no-clip into the backrooms:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/96a4582d65a99d8f108025c6e8ab7d97ae62fca6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/22c2cdabc310473f416088677c613fec40163a9a.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added an inventory system
[*] Added a sanity system
[*] Changed normal difficulty to spectate players when you die
[*] Added a hard difficulty which kills every player if one player dies
[*] Changed easy mode to not decrease sanity and only require one player to find the exit
[*] Changed nightmare mode to decrease 1.5x sanity
[*] Added the ability to reset your achievements in the settings menu
[/list]

Enjoy!
